role_boundaries.BOSS: WebUI RoleChannel + ControlStore server auth, owner scope fixed ui-check in demo
role_boundaries.MAINTAINER: same gateway; maintenance metadata and one simulation feedback action only
role_boundaries.ANONYMOUS: nanobot original login, no business access

notes: 72 pages are navigable by already-authenticated role; this does not mean 72 completed React business pages.

Back-end HTTP GET /api/boss/ui/* routes return actual persisted selection data through BossPageAPI. Mutation actions use authenticated nanobot requestMutation, not browser-side SQLite or direct unauthenticated HTTP POST.

The role-scoped commands are boss.assignment.{create,send,complete,extend,cancel} and boss.simulation.feedback; each has its own server-side command whitelist, transaction, audit, version and idempotency receipt.
Task completion requires result submitted with currently valid evidence and a separate authenticated BOSS decision. Simulated feedback never marks completed.
Real Mac visual snapshots, actual DeepSeek+UI complete walkthrough and end-to-end E01-E06 remain not verified in this development slice.
T08 must replace all remaining semantic placeholders with real components, service operation IDs and event contracts before acceptance.
F24 and A15 use read-only, local metadata-only DeepSeek diagnostics; absence of response is explicit, no model success or cost is inferred from configuration.

2026-10-22 implementation slice: 36 modular workplace routes and 13 agriculture coverage routes added; existing A04 counts once. 61/72 pages have at least partial real code/role-scoped read data; none of these 61 is thereby accepted as functionally complete.

Agriculture pages only render verified source coverage and unknown KPIs: the selected water-feed sales note is not evidence for raw-material prices and does not support other sector metrics. All sector numeric KPIs are NULL and require new approved datasets.

Remaining action gaps, 561 visual states, end-to-end Mac/DeepSeek/voice/installation, source/metric completeness and pixel-accurate visual comparison are not accepted. Metadata-only page content does not satisfy PRD write or approval actions.

D03 and F30 are read-only runtime diagnostic views; A06 delegates to upstream Skills catalog; F31 renders the real evaluation definition but no actual score. None is accepted as an end-to-end PRD feature.

F27 records locally and requests the native authenticated transcribeAudio operation only after user action. Transcription remains disabled by default until a real STT provider is configured and tested; no success/e2e assertions are made.
F05 meeting minutes are versioned and grouped OPINION/SUGGESTION/DECISION/ASSIGNMENT_DRAFT; owner confirmed only after original source check. No assignment is auto-created or sent.

F07 application approvals must originate from explicit MAINTAINER simulated data in A03, with exact amount/currency and source version. REJECT/APPROVE/REQUEST_MORE are distinct. Revision after REQUEST_MORE invalidates old approvals; no financial transaction.
The redesigned Desktop v6 shell now follows source desktop layout geometry (64px topbar, 146/122px Hero, 204px sidebar, 278px right information column); macOS screenshot pixel diff remains NOT_RUN.

F08 now has versioned draft/save/simulated send/reply with actual SQLite records and owner consent; SENT_SIMULATED is distinct from external delivery and reply. Reply injection is a separate MAINTAINER action; it does not confirm task completion.

F12 owner-only private calendar edit/delete and busy-only scope sharing/revocation: title/location/body cannot enter the share object; private content is not readable through maintenance API. No actual external invite is sent.

Functional priority patch: F05/F06/F07/F08/F12/F13/N06/N07/N08/A04 can re-query a persisted original idempotency receipt after uncertain WebSocket responses; absence is NOT proof of failed delivery. No datasets added.

FR12 calendar-conflict reads the same authoritative single-meeting conflict classification used by calendar.save; missing meeting end remains unknown. Busy shares are ineffective after expiry, revoke or calendar-version change; owner preview only, no recipient account or external delivery.

F08 cannot send a message linked to an OPEN assignment before separate owner-authorized assignment send; contact ID validity is checked against current simulated clock and duplicate attachments are rejected.

FR04 owner-authenticated meeting briefing preparation is versioned in real SQLite with deterministic metric aggregation and source state; any document/participant/task/event change can yield NEEDS_REVIEW without rewriting old snapshots. Missing-material requests become F08 DRAFT only, never SENT.
